algorithm.append_protocol: before every store of n bytes (1, 2 or 4 for the header pieces; the full string length for the payload) the routine compares the remaining capacity (capacity - length) with n; when remaining < n it calls the growth routine 0x5963a10 with (descriptor, current length, additional = n, rcx = 1, r8 = 1), reloads the data pointer and the length, and stores without re-checking
algorithm.header_decision: on the low 32 bits L of the length argument: L < 0x20 -> one byte 0xa0 | L (fixstr); L < 0x100 -> byte 0xd9 then L as one byte (str 8); L < 0x10000 -> byte 0xda then L as a two-byte big-endian store (rol $8 on the low word) (str 16); otherwise -> byte 0xdb then L as a four-byte big-endian store (bswap) (str 32)
algorithm.payload: one capacity decision for the whole string (growth with additional = the full length when it exceeds the remaining capacity), then a single memcpy of the full length through GOT slot 0x64df508 (memcpy@GLIBC_2.14) to data + length; a zero-length payload takes neither the growth call nor the memcpy
algorithm.return: the single exit stores the constant pair rax = 2, rdx = 0; there is no other exit and no error path in the body

consumers.argument_setup: the wrapper at FDE 0x57c1130..0x57c1196 calls at 0x57c1179 with (rdi = caller-supplied buffer descriptor, rsi = a bytes pointer its own callee just produced, rdx = the wrapper's length argument) and overwrites rax immediately afterwards: it ignores the return pair and treats the write as infallible
consumers.sites: 903 direct calls in 440 caller FDEs across the binary (callers.tsv); every raw rel32 candidate is confirmed by objdump's own disassembly — no false positives, no tail jumps, no stored qwords, no relocations: the routine is reached only by direct code transfer

main: growth routine 0x5963a10 at eight direct call sites: 0x57cf738 (fixstr byte), 0x57cf762 (str 8 marker), 0x57cf78f (str 8 length byte), 0x57cf7bd (str 16 marker), 0x57cf7ea (str 16 length store, additional = 2), 0x57cf818 (str 32 marker), 0x57cf845 (str 32 length store, additional = 4), 0x57cf70d (payload, additional = the full string length)
memcpy@GLIBC_2.14 at 0x57cf6d9, indirect through GOT slot 0x64df508 (R_X86_64_GLOB_DAT, relocations.txt)

object_layout.buffer_descriptor: rdi: +0x00 capacity in bytes (read), +0x08 data pointer (read), +0x10 current length (read; stored after every step). This routine never stores the capacity or the data pointer — only the growth routine stores those, on its success path
object_layout.inputs: rsi = payload bytes pointer; rdx = payload length in bytes: the header decision reads only its low 32 bits, the payload capacity check and the memcpy count use the full 64-bit value

routines.inputs: rdi = buffer descriptor (+0x00 capacity, +0x08 data pointer, +0x10 length), rsi = payload bytes pointer, rdx = payload length in bytes
routines.name: MessagePack str writer (header decision, append protocol, payload copy)
routines.outputs: the buffer holds the previous contents followed by the MessagePack str header and the payload bytes, with the descriptor's length advanced by the header size plus the payload length; the routine returns the constant pair rax = 2, rdx = 0

unknowns: The type-level meaning of the constant return pair (2, 0): the body stores it on its only exit and the one inspected consumer ignores it, but which enum or result type it encodes is the callers' ABI question.

Whether any caller can pass a length whose low 32 bits misstate the payload: the header decision trusts the low word while the copy uses the full length; auditing all 440 caller bodies is out of scope.
The caller bodies beyond the one inspected wrapper at 0x57c1130: the census pins all 903 sites and their FDEs, but each caller's argument setup is that caller's own question.

The two instruction-identical copies at 0x159f9c0 and 0x25e8bf0 (650 bytes each, instruction streams identical after normalizing embedded addresses, each calling its own neighbourhood's growth routine): their caller sets and any divergence in their growth routines are separate questions.
unwind: the routine's FDE references CIE 0, whose augmentation is 'zR' (no 'L', no personality), and the FDE's own augmentation length is 0: the routine has no LSDA and no landing pads, so a raise out of the growth routine or out of memcpy runs no cleanup in this frame
